name: the-sshid-sandbox
description: Termius SSH ID provisioned local/remote sandbox substrate. Public keys only via sshid.io + restricted Docker/Podman or dedicated-user runs for safe agent execution on own PC.

interface.shortDescription: Own-PC sandbox runs via SSH + Termius SSH ID public-key provision
interface.longDescription: Provisions authorized_keys from https://sshid.io/<handle>, creates restricted Docker/Podman sandboxes or dedicated users, and supplies copy-paste commands for safe agent execution over SSH. Never handles private keys. Compose with the-netsshark for pre-flight connectivity.
defaultPrompt: Set up an SSH sandbox on my PC using Termius SSH ID
Provision sshid.io keys for a restricted sandbox user
Run a command in the the-sshid-sandbox Docker wrapper
Show the rollback and cleanup for the-sshid-sandbox
